opinion.headline: Go and see
opinion.hook: Gossip spreads quickly and can cause harm.
opinion.summary: It is better to pause idle talk and verify information. Toyota's Genchi Genbutsu principle encourages seeing things for yourself. Apply this to negative talk about others. Seek firsthand confirmation instead of speculating. Wise people let gossip die. Let us be wise and avoid gossip. It harms everyone involved.
